title: Western blot analysis of sub-cellular fractionated samples using the Odyssey Infrared Imaging System
protocol: Lysate cells with 0.5% Triton X-100 lysis buffer.
Incubate lysed cells on ice for 15 min.
Centrifuge the mixture at 13 krpm for 15 min at 4°C to separate insoluble nuclei.
Transfer supernatant into a new Eppendorf tube.
Take small aliquots of the membrane/cytoplasmic fraction for DNA contamination detection.
Rinse nuclear pellet with lysis buffer, then resuspend in buffer containing 0.5% SDS.
Sonicate the mixture for 5 seconds at output 2 using Brandon Sonifier 450 to shear genomic DNA.
Pre-clear by centrifugation at 13 krpm for 15 min at 4°C.
Add an equal amount of 2x SDS-PAGE sample buffer to nuclear and membrane/cytoplasmic fractions.
Boil both tubes containing the nuclear and membrane/cytoplasmic fractions for 10 min.
Run the gel at 15 mA until the dyefront reaches the separation gel, then increase to 30 mA per gel.
Wet Immobilon-FL membrane in MeOH for 15 seconds.
Rinse the membrane with ddH2O.
Pre-soak the membrane in transfer buffer for more than 30 minutes.
Transfer the proteins onto the pre-soaked Immobilon-FL membrane using a TE22 Mini Tank Transfer Unit at 100 V for 70 minutes or 90 V for 80 minutes, depending on protein size.
Rinse the membrane with PBST.
Block the membrane with 5% fat-free dried milk in PBST for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Incubate the membrane with primary antibody diluted in blotting buffer \(1:500-2,000\) for one hour at room temperature.
Wash the membrane four times with PBST for 15 minutes each.
Incubate the membrane with secondary antibodies diluted in 5% fat-free dried milk in PBST for 45 to 60 min at room temperature with gentle agitation on a rocking plate.
Keep the membrane away from light during incubation and subsequent steps.
Wash the membrane four times with PBST for 15 min each.
Rinse the membrane with PBS before scanning using the Odyssey system.
Set the Odyssey system as follows: preset to membrane, resolution to 169 mm, quality to medium, and focus offset to 0.0.
Scan the membrane using the Odyssey system settings specified.
